senses.gloss: (act. verb) to turn; to change; to reverse; to pervert, subvert, destroy.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 18:9">Ex. R. s. 18</cite> <he>הָפְכָה המדינה שעבודה וכ׳</he> a country perverted the rules of forced labor for the captives (treating them inhumanely); <he>ה׳ עליהם את הדין וכ׳</he> he changed the law against them and put them to death by night (against the Jewish law, v.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 4:1">Ib.</cite> <he>ה׳ סדום</he> He destroyed Sodom.
<cite ref="Berakhot 55b:11">Ber. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>כשם שהָפַכְתָּ וכ׳</he> as thou didst turn the curse … into blessing, <he>כן הֲפוֹךְ וכ׳</he> so do thou turn &c.
B. Kam. III, 3 ההוֹפֵךְ את הגלל he who upturns (changes the place of) the dung (taking possession); a. v. fr.—Part. Pass. הָפוּךְ.
<cite ref="Pesachim 50a:6">Pes. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>עולם ה׳ ראיתי וכ׳</he> I saw a reversed world, the uppermost below &c.

<cite ref="Shabbat 108b:9">Sabb. 108ᵇ</cite> <he>הֲפוּכָה סדום וכ׳</he> Sodom is subverted and what is said about it is perverted. Sifra Thazr. Par. 3, ch. III <cite ref="E00727"><he>הפוך</he></cite>, <he>הפוכה</he> when its color is changed; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 5:4:2">Y. Naz. V, end, 54ᵇ</cite> <he>לשון הפוך</he>, v. <cite ref="E00742"><he>הֶפֶךְ</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (neut. verb) to change. Sifra ch. IV אי כולי ה׳ לבן if the whole of it has turned white.
to be upturned, destroyed; to be changed.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1056:15">Yalk. Esth. 1056</cite> <he>כשנ׳ סדום</he> when Sodom was subverted.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 50:9">Gen. R. s. 50</cite> <he>ומדינה נֶהְפֶּכֶת</he>, v. <cite ref="A00450"><he>אִדְרַבְלָא</he></cite>. Tanḥ. Sh’moth 25 <he>נ׳ להם מן וכ׳</he> the voice turned around, as if coming from &c.; a. fr.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:1">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> <he>שהי׳ דברים וכ׳</he> who spoke perversely of the Creator.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 59a:6">Kidd. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>עני מְהַפֵּךְ וכ׳</he> a poor man turns the cake, and another comes and takes it, i.e. one who buys away what another is negotiating for.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 21:1">Gen. R. s. 21</cite> end <he>שהם מִתְהַפְּכִים</he> they (the angels) assume various shapes.

senses.gloss: to turn one’s self around. Ib. שהיא מִתְהַפֶּכֶת וכ׳ for it (the fiery sword) turns around man &c.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 35a">Yeb. 35ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Ketubot 37a:7">Keth. 37ᵃ</cite> <he>מתהפכת</he> she turns herself (makes violent motions).
<cite ref="Ketubot 37a:7">Ib.</cite> <he>נִתְהַפְּכָה</he> (Keth. l. c. <he>נֶהֶפְכָה</he>).—Tanḥ. Vayetsé 11 <he>היה מ׳ עליו</he> prevaricated (changing terms).

senses.gloss: to scheme. Ruth R. introd. 3 שהוא מִתְהפֵּךְ ובא וכ׳ he (Esaw = Rome) schemes and comes against &c.; Yalk. Prov. 959 בא ומְהַפֵּךְ על וכ׳.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 959:37">Ib.</cite> <he>שהם מִתְהַפְּכִים וכ׳</he>; Ruth R. l. c. <he>שמְהַפְּכִין</he>.
